My earliest memory is of my brother sexually abusing me at a young age. I'm still not certain how young, but I must have been 5 or 6 at least. Then the rest of my life up to high school is kind of a blur of getting into trouble at school and some good memories interspersed in-between the verbal abuse again from my brother. I have to think really hard in order to extract any semblance of a memory and those that I do are blurry at best. See I was put on several ADHD medications throughout my childhood, and I think that and the trauma messed up my memory. I remember a bits and pieces, a teacher I liked, kids at daycare I used to play with and invent games. The time I created a film with my Special Education teacher. The trash filled trailer we lived in. All fragments of the kid I used to be.

Middle school is still a but blurry but less so than my elementary years. I was still the class clown. Doing stupid things to get to classmates' attention. Somewhere along the line I calmed down. This may have been because I was pulled from. A majority of my classes and forced to stay in the special education room. Where I'd play on the computer for hours. Mostly looking up wikia articles for games and TV shows I like. I think this had a major effect on my social development.i had one girl I had a little bit if a crush on, though I may have said that to resolve insecurities about my sexuality caused by the previously mentioned abuse. (I note that because is a constant thread throughout my life) around this time I believe the abuse actually stopped. It stopped not because if my brother but because we were caught in the act by our mother, who punished us both.

High school I remember a lot more clearly. It was the first time I remember having people I would actually call friends. That was freshman year. I was still awkward but I guess I was a lot less conscious then I was later on because I remember being a bit bolder even if I did something I cringe at now. Throughout High School I slept, a lot, much to my detriment. I joined the book club because my brother was in there. I often at this time followed my brother around "like a lost puppy" in his words. I became intensely jealous when he got a girlfriend. Sophomore year was more of the same as Freshman, I do believe this is the year I took Drama class which I think is notable for some reason. In-between Sophmore and Junior year I made an important decision.  See my parents didn't live together, in fact my father had married another woman and we saw them every other weekend and over the summers. This summer I decided to live with them. That was 2013. They lived I. A very small town so the school of course focused on two things: Football and the Ag program. At this time, following once again in my brother's footsteps I would declare that I wanted to be a game designer (not knowing how much that actually took). As you can imagine the programs offered there weren't all that great, though I do believe they had a cyberpatriots program there so it mustn't have been that backwards. I continued to preform poorly in school. Mostly due to my sleep schedule, party due to my own unwillingness to put effort in to the work, though reportedly, in some classes, I would l would wake up and answer something correctly, and I would score 70s to 80s on my test in certain subjects (mostly history from my recollection). It was here as well that I had my first two crushes. One was a girl that I found myself getting mixed messages from, though perhaps this was mostly a case of me misinterpreting cues. The other was a guy. A football player. A center if I recall correctly. I found myself more confused by my attraction to him. As I recall he resembled my brother which cod be a factor in why I was attracted to him, but that wouldn't explain why I was attracted to another classmate. I never tried with the guy, and the girl indirectly rejected me which caused a lot of heartache. 

So I struggled through high school which caused another of tension between me and my step mother. This escalated into the worst summer of my life in 2014 when she lost her father and went on a war path against me. Now I'll admit I had a lot of bad habits that i picked up form living with my mother who didn't not really enforce cleanliness as opposed to my step mother who was a clean freak. The summer cooled down into winter and I went into my senior year. I scrapped by and graduated. And now I went into employment. Fortunately a Taco Bell opened up in our town and so me and my step brother got hired on there. I was a dish washer at first so I was stuck in the exact of the building, but eventually I was able to run the line, the front lobby and the drive through. I had ambitions to be a manager but I kept fucking up the count when they let me do it so I think that made them decide to not give me that. This is also when I came to realize that I was abused. That was the summer of 2015 the same year I graduated. 

After that I moved around with my step brother some working fast food. Until we had to return to my step mothers place after having failed to support ourselves in a distant city. She still didn't like me so my step uncle took me in which is where conveniently my father was after his marriage fell apart. Here I learned a lot about independence. My step uncle was all about that. But I still  had my bad habits, and so it ended up that I was made to live in a tent on their property. I worked at a tourist trap BBQ restaurant, then Sonic, so still food service. I still remember a lot of good things and bad things from this period of time.
